mapper.update: UPDATE t_chat_session_member SET last_read_sequence = GREATEST(last_read_sequence, #{lastReadSequence}), unread_count = CASE WHEN #{lastReadSequence} >= #{currentLastSequence} THEN 0 ELSE unread_count END WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id, s.session_type, peer.user_id AS peer_user_id, s.last_sequence, s.last_message, s.last_message_time, member.unread_count, member.last_read_sequence, s.create_time FROM t_chat_session_member member INNER JOIN t_chat_session s ON s.session_id = member.session_id LEFT JOIN t_chat_session_member peer ON peer.session_id = member.session_id AND s.session_type = 1 AND peer.user_id != member.user_id WHERE member.user_id = #{userId} AND member.is_deleted = 0 AND s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY COALESCE(s.last_message_time, s.create_time) DESC, s.session_id DESC
